record.original_question: Extend the action-angle theorem in a neighbourhood of a Liou ville torus at singular points of the Poisson structure. So there is no simultaneous splitting theorem for the Poisson structure and the integrable system. Counterexamples to this decomposability can be found in [14 3]. artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,\Pi)$ be a smooth Poisson manifold and let $F=(f_1,\dots,f_n):M\to\mathbb{R}^n$ be an integrable system on $(M,\Pi)$, meaning that the functions $f_i$ pairwise Poisson-commute, $\{f_i,f_j\}_\Pi=0$, and are functionally independent on a dense open subset, with the number of independent commuting functions matching the rank conditions of an integrable system on a Poisson manifold. Suppose $p\in M$ is a point at which the Poisson tensor $\Pi$ is singular (its rank drops), and suppose that the connected component of the fiber $F^{-1}(F(p))$ containing $p$ is a compact regular Liouville torus $\mathbb{T}^r$ of the symplectic foliation. Call the integrable system splittable near $p$ if there exist a neighbourhood $U$ of $p$ and a Poisson isomorphism of $U$ with a product $(S,\omega_S)\times(N,\Pi_N)$ of a symplectic manifold and a transverse Poisson manifold, such that $F$ decomposes as the sum of an integrable system on $S$ and an integrable system on $N$.

Problem: For splittable integrable systems on Poisson manifolds, establish an action–angle theorem in a neighbourhood of a Liouville torus that lies over a singular point of the Poisson structure. Explicitly, construct coordinates $(\theta_1,\dots,\theta_r,p_1,\dots,p_r,z_1,\dots,z_{s})$ on a saturated neighbourhood of the torus, where the $\theta_i$ are angle coordinates on $\mathbb{T}^r$, the $p_i$ are action coordinates conjugate to them on the symplectic leaf, and the $z_j$ are transverse coordinates, in which the Poisson bracket and the integrable system $F$ take a normal form generalising the classical Liouville–Mineur–Arnold theorem.
artifact.status_search_result: Action-angle theorems near regular Liouville tori on Poisson manifolds (Laurent-Gengoux–Miranda–Vanhaecke) and near singular points of integrable systems on symplectic manifolds (Eliasson, Miranda–Zung) are known, and partial results exist for b-integrable systems on singular symplectic manifolds. However, the general action-angle theorem near a Liouville torus sitting over a singular point of the Poisson structure for splittable systems does not appear to have been established in full generality; the problem is repeatedly listed as open in surveys of finite-dimensional integrable systems.

status_evidence.title: Action-angle coordinates for integrable systems on Poisson manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Theorem establishes the existence of action and angle coordinates in a neighborhood of a Liouville torus on a Poisson manifold where the fiber is a standard Liouville torus.
status_evidence.claim: The classical action-angle theorem on Poisson manifolds is established at points where the Liouville torus is a standard one; extension to singular points of the Poisson tensor remains a stated open problem.
